@lexfridman Disagree.  Dogecoin is trolling.

The best I can say about Musk, and others, pumping DogeCoin is that some people are going to learn the hard way (by losing money), the lesson not to believe everything they read.

@APompliano What fascinates me is that the people who hold Doge aren't asking why @Tesla has #Bitcoin on it's balance sheet and not #dogecoin.   

I've always thought it was better to look at what a person is doing and not what they are saying.  Maybe it's just me...
